cards.name: Accursed Duneyard
lines: {2}, {T}: Regenerate target Shade, Skeleton, Specter, Spirit, Vampire, Wraith, or Zombie.
cards.backTranslation: {2}, {T}: Regenerate target permanent that is a Shade, Skeleton, Specter, Spirit, Vampire, Wraith, or Zombie.

cards.name: Bruvac the Grandiloquent
lines: If an opponent would mill one or more cards, they mill twice that many cards instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The replacement schema has no mill-count replacement: tokenCountMultiplier and counterPlacementReplacement cover tokens and counters only, so doubling an opponent's mill cannot be stated.

cards.name: Plargg and Nassari
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, each player exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a nonland card. An opponent chooses a nonland card exiled this way. You may cast up to two spells from among the other cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
cards.inexpressibleReason: exileEachUntilNonlandCast lets the caster cast any number of the exiled nonland cards, but this line has an opponent choose one card that cannot be cast and limits the casts to two, and no op models that choice.

cards.name: Brudiclad, Telchor Engineer
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a 2/1 blue Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token. Then you may choose a token you control. If you do, each other token you control becomes a copy of that token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op makes each other token become a copy of a chosen token; createTokenCopyOf only creates new tokens.

cards.name: Sedgemoor Witch
lines: Ward—Pay 3 life.
cards.backTranslation: Ward—Pay 3 life.

cards.name: Kwain, Itinerant Meddler
lines: {T}: Each player may draw a card, then each player who drew a card this way gains 1 life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: eachPlayerDraws is mandatory for every player and no op lets each player optionally draw and then gain life for each player who drew, so 'each player may draw a card, then each player who drew a card this way gains 1 life' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Master Transmuter
lines: {U}, {T}, Return an artifact you control to its owner's hand: You may put an artifact card from your hand onto the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cost "Return an artifact you control to its owner's hand" has no AbilityCost kind, since the schema's only return-style cost is for an Equipment unattaching, so the activation cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Neoform
lines: Search your library for a creature card with mana value equal to 1 plus the sacrificed creature's mana value, put that card onto the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The search filter can bound mana value only by a fixed number, not by one plus the sacrificed creature's mana value.

cards.name: Manglehorn
lines: Artifacts your opponents control enter tapped.
cards.backTranslation: Artifacts your opponents control enter the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Arcane Bombardment
lines: Whenever you cast your first instant or sorcery spell each turn, exile an instant or sorcery card at random from your graveyard. Then copy each card exiled with this enchantment. You may cast any number of the copies without paying their mana costs.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect exiles a random instant or sorcery card from the graveyard, copies the cards exiled with this enchantment, or lets those copies be cast for free.

cards.name: Survival of the Fittest
lines: {G}, Discard a creature card: Search your library for a creature card, reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The discard cost (discardCard) cannot be restricted to creature cards.

cards.name: Lignify
lines: Enchanted creature is a Treefolk with base power and toughness 0/4 and loses all abilities.
cards.backTranslation: Enchanted creature has only the creature type Treefolk, loses all abilities, and has base power and toughness 0/4.
differences: Text A makes the enchanted creature a Treefolk and keeps its other creature types; Text B says it has only the creature type Treefolk, removing its other creature types.

cards.name: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
lines: Whenever ~ enters or attacks, sacrifice another permanent.
cards.backTranslation:
When this enters, sacrifice one other permanent you control.
Whenever this attacks, sacrifice one other permanent you control.

cards.name: Conclave Mentor
lines: When this creature dies, you gain life equal to its power.
cards.backTranslation: When this dies, you gain life equal to its power.

cards.name: Dictate of the Twin Gods
lines: If a source would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals double that damage to that permanent or player instead.
cards.backTranslation: Damage from any source is doubled.

cards.name: Endbringer
lines: {C}, {T}: Target creature can't attack or block this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect op stops a target creature from both attacking and blocking this turn; cantBlockEachChosenThisTurn covers only blocking and addAttackRequirement only forces attacks.

cards.name: Niv-Mizzet, Visionary
lines: Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent, you draw that many cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No trigger fires on noncombat damage dealt to an opponent by any source you control: dealsDamageToOpponent covers only the source's own damage, and playerDealtDamage covers only damage from opponents' sources.

cards.name: Whelming Wave
lines: Return all creatures to their owners' hands except for Krakens, Leviathans, Octopuses, and Serpents.
cards.backTranslation: Return each creature on the battlefield that isn't a Kraken, Leviathan, Octopus, or Serpent to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Forsaken Miner
lines: Whenever you commit a crime, you may pay {B}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no trigger event for 'whenever you commit a crime' (targeting opponents, their permanents, or their graveyard cards), so the triggered line cannot be stated.

cards.name: Ringsight
lines: The Ring tempts you. Search your library for a card that shares a color with a legendary creature you control, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no Ring-tempts-you effect, and the search filter cannot express "shares a color with a legendary creature you control".

cards.name: Crowded Crypt
lines: {4}{B}{B}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed for each corpse counter on this artifact.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The token must have decayed (can't block, and is sacrificed at end of combat after it attacks), and the schema has no decayed keyword or token blocking restriction that could express it.

cards.name: Brilliant Restoration
lines: Return all artifact and enchantment cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: Return each artifact card and each enchantment card in your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: The Regalia
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card. Put that card onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect reveals cards from the top of a library until a land is found and puts that card onto the battlefield; revealUntilAura covers only Auras.

cards.name: Pyrohemia
lines: At the beginning of the end step, if no creatures are on the battlefield, sacrifice this enchantment.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of each player's end step, if the number of creatures on the battlefield is less than or equal to 0, sacrifice this.

cards.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
lines: Noncreature spells cost {1} more to cast.
cards.inexpressibleReason: "Noncreature spells cost {1} more to cast" applies to every player's spells, and the schema has no all-player cost-increase static: costReduction only lowers cost, and opponentNonHandSpellCostIncrease covers only opponents' spells cast outside hand.

cards.name: Worldspine Wurm
lines: When ~ is put into a graveyard from anywhere, shuffle it into its owner's library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The only graveyard-to-library shuffle op (shuffleSourceFromGraveyardIntoLibrary) puts the card into its controller's library, not its owner's library as the line says.

cards.name: Sol Talisman
lines: Suspend 3—{1}
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no suspend cast or exile-with-time-counters mechanic, so Suspend 3 cannot be stated.

cards.name: Wavebreak Hippocamp
lines: Whenever you cast your first spell during each opponent's turn, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast your first spell in a turn that isn't your turn, draw a card.

cards.name: Ezuri, Renegade Leader
lines: {G}: Regenerate another target Elf.
cards.backTranslation: {G}: Regenerate target permanent other than this creature that has the creature type Elf.

cards.name: Abundant Growth
lines: Enchanted land has "{T}: Add one mana of any color."
cards.backTranslation: Enchanted creature has "{T}: Add {W}, {U}, {B}, {R}, or {G}."
differences: Text A gives the enchanted land the mana ability; Text B gives the enchanted creature the ability, so the affected object is different (land versus creature).
Text A's mana is one mana of any color; Text B's is a fixed choice of {W}, {U}, {B}, {R}, or {G}.

cards.name: Lim-Dûl's Vault
lines: Look at the top five cards of your library. As many times as you choose, you may pay 1 life, put those cards on the bottom of your library in any order, then look at the top five cards of your library. Then shuffle and put the last cards you looked at this way on top in any order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The line repeats a player-chosen number of times a pay-1-life, bottom-the-cards, look-again loop, and the schema has no repeatable player-choice loop.

cards.name: The Indomitable
lines: You may cast this card from your graveyard as long as you control three or more tapped Pirates and/or Vehicles.
cards.inexpressibleReason: castFromGraveyard is an unconditional permission, and no graveyard-cast permission is gated on controlling three or more tapped Pirates and/or Vehicles.

cards.name: Envoy of the Ancestors
lines: Modified creatures you control have lifelink.
cards.backTranslation: Creatures you control that are equipped, enchanted by an Aura you control, or have a counter on them have lifelink.

cards.name: Sandwurm Convergence
lines: Creatures with flying can't attack you or planeswalkers you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The flying restriction needs a static selector for 'creatures with flying', but the schema's hasKeyword selector is event-only, so it cannot filter an attackRestriction.

cards.name: Force of Despair
lines: Destroy all creatures that entered this turn.
cards.backTranslation: Destroy each creature that entered the battlefield this turn.

cards.name: God-Pharaoh's Statue
lines: Spells your opponents cast cost {2} more to cast.
cards.inexpressibleReason: opponentNonHandSpellCostIncrease covers only spells cast from outside the hand, and no rule static taxes all spells opponents cast.

cards.name: Tinder Wall
lines: {R}, Sacrifice this creature: It deals 2 damage to target creature it's blocking.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The target must be the creature this Wall is blocking, and no target restriction or selector can express "creature it's blocking" (only generic combat role), so the damage target cannot be expressed exactly.

cards.name: Alibou, Ancient Witness
lines: Whenever one or more artifact creatures you control attack, ~ deals X damage to any target and you scry X, where X is the number of tapped artifacts you control.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you attack with an artifact creature you control, this deals damage to any target equal to the number of tapped artifacts you control, then scry X, where X is the number of tapped artifacts you control.

cards.name: Winds of Change
lines: Each player shuffles the cards from their hand into their library, then draws that many cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect shuffles each player's hand into their library and then draws that many cards (eachPlayerDiscardHandThenDraw discards, and putAnyFromHandOnBottomThenDraw puts cards on the bottom).

cards.name: Urban Evolution
lines: Draw three cards. You may play an additional land this turn.
cards.backTranslation:
Draw three cards.
You may play one additional land this turn.

cards.name: Crimson Wisps
lines: Target creature becomes red and gains haste until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect makes a targeted creature become red until end of turn: becomeCreatureUntilEot also changes its types and power/toughness, and color-setting (layer 5) exists only as a static effect, not as a resolving effect on a target.

cards.name: Blade of the Bloodchief
lines: Whenever a creature dies, put a +1/+1 counter on equipped creature. If equipped creature is a Vampire, put two +1/+1 counters on it instead.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature dies, if equipped creature is a Vampire, put two +1/+1 counters on equipped creature. Otherwise, put one +1/+1 counter on equipped creature.

cards.name: Molten Echoes
lines: Whenever a nontoken creature you control of the chosen type enters, create a token that's a copy of that creature. That token gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The copy must be exiled at the next end step, but createTokenCopyOf's sacrificeAt only sacrifices, which would wrongly fire dies triggers.

cards.name: Harmonized Crescendo
lines: Choose a creature type. Draw a card for each permanent you control of that type.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A resolving spell cannot choose a creature type, since chosenSubtype reads only a permanent's chosen option.

cards.name: Captivating Vampire
lines: Tap five untapped Vampires you control: Gain control of target creature. It becomes a Vampire in addition to its other types.
cards.inexpressibleReason: After gaining control of the target creature, it must also become a Vampire in addition to its other types, and no static or effect can add a subtype to the one creature this effect gained control of.

cards.name: Ivy Lane Denizen
lines: Whenever another green creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever another green creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.

cards.name: Runic Armasaur
lines: Whenever an opponent activates an ability of a creature or land that isn't a mana ability, you may draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The activatesAbility trigger watches only its controller's own abilities (player 'you') and has no opponent or source-type filter, so it cannot fire on an opponent's creature or land abilities.

cards.name: Villainous Wealth
lines: Target opponent exiles the top X cards of their library. You may cast any number of spells with mana value X or less from among them without paying their mana costs.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No schema op makes a target opponent exile X cards where X is announced and then lets the caster cast spells of mana value X or less from them free: exileLibraryTop takes no count or target, and lookAtTopNCastOneFree casts only one card.

cards.name: Aminatou's Augury
lines: Exile the top eight cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield. Until end of turn, for each nonland card type, you may cast a spell of that type from among the exiled cards without paying its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Casting one free spell for each nonland card type among the exiled cards has no op, since lookAtTopNCastOneFree casts only one spell, and the optional land put onto the battlefield is a separate choice.

cards.name: Fear of Missing Out
lines: Whenever this creature attacks for the first time each turn, if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, untap target creature. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
cards.backTranslation:
Whenever this creature attacks, if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, untap target creature. This ability triggers only once each turn.
After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.

cards.name: Astral Dragon
lines: Project Image — When this creature enters, create two tokens that are copies of target noncreature permanent, except they're 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types, and they have flying.
cards.inexpressibleReason: createTokenCopyOf can add card types to the copies but cannot add the Dragon creature subtype, so the tokens cannot be made 3/3 Dragon creatures.

cards.name: Collector Ouphe
lines: Activated abilities of artifacts can't be activated.
cards.backTranslation: Activated abilities of artifacts can't be activated.

cards.name: Samwise Gamgee
lines: Sacrifice three Foods: Return target historic card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.backTranslation: Sacrifice three Foods you control: Put target artifact, legendary, or Saga card from your graveyard into your hand.

cards.name: Weatherlight
lines: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a historic card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this deals combat damage to a player, look at the top five cards of your library. You may put an artifact card, a Legendary card, or a Saga card from among them into your hand, revealing it. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

cards.name: Brightstone Ritual
lines: Add {R} for each Goblin on the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: Add {R} for each Goblin permanent on the battlefield under any player's control.

cards.name: Voldaren Estate
lines: {5}, {T}: Create a Blood token. This ability costs {1} less to activate for each Vampire you control.
cards.backTranslation: {5}, {T}: Create a Blood artifact token. This ability costs less to activate by an amount equal to the number of Vampires you control.

cards.name: Sundering Growth
lines: Destroy target artifact or enchantment, then populate.
cards.backTranslation:
Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
Populate.

cards.name: Gogo, Mysterious Mime
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may have ~ become a copy of another target creature you control until end of turn, except its name is ~. If you do, ~ and that creature each get +2/+0 and gain haste until end of turn and attack this turn if able.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may choose another target creature you control. This creature becomes a copy of that creature until end of turn, with the name given by this ability. Until end of turn, this creature gets +2/+0 and that creature gets +2/+0. Until end of turn, this creature and that creature each have haste. This creature attacks this combat if able, and that creature attacks this combat if able.

cards.name: Echoing Deeps
lines: You may have this land enter tapped as a copy of any land card in a graveyard, except it's a Cave in addition to its other types.
cards.inexpressibleReason: entersAsCopy selects only battlefield permanents, so it cannot name a land card in a graveyard as the copy source.

cards.name: Y'shtola Rhul
lines: At the beginning of your end step, exile target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. Then if it's the first end step of the turn, there is an additional end step after this step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that adds an additional end step after the current one, so the 'if it's the first end step of the turn, there is an additional end step' clause cannot be stated.

cards.name: Debt to the Deathless
lines: Each opponent loses two times X life. You gain life equal to the life lost this way.
cards.backTranslation:
Each opponent loses twice X life.
You gain life equal to the life lost this way.

cards.name: Ilharg, the Raze-Boar
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, you may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking. Return that creature to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op puts a creature card from hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking, nor returns that card to its owner's hand at the next end step.

cards.name: Odric, Master Tactician
lines: Whenever ~ and at least three other creatures attack, you choose which creatures block this combat and how those creatures block.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The controller chooses only the blocks, but chooseAttackersAndBlockers also has the controller choose the attackers, and no op limits the choice to blockers.

cards.name: Ancient Stone Idol
lines: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each attacking creature.
cards.backTranslation: This spell costs less to cast for each attacking creature.
differences: Text A reduces the cost by {1} for each attacking creature; Text B says the cost is reduced for each attacking creature but omits the amount of the reduction.

cards.name: Valley Rotcaller
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of other Squirrels, Bats, Lizards, and Rats you control.
cards.backTranslation: From your graveyard, sacrifice a Food you control other than this creature: Return this card to the battlefield.
differences: Text A is an attack trigger that drains based on other Squirrels, Bats, Lizards, and Rats you control; Text B describes a graveyard ability that sacrifices a Food to return the card to the battlefield, and does not contain the attack trigger.

cards.name: Harsh Mentor
lines: Whenever an opponent activates an ability of an artifact, creature, or land on the battlefield, if it isn't a mana ability, this creature deals 2 damage to that player.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The activatesAbility trigger only watches abilities its controller activates, with no form for an opponent's activations.

cards.name: Life's Legacy
lines: Draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value reads the power of the creature sacrificed as an additional cost, so the draw count cannot be stated.

cards.name: Merchant Scroll
lines: Search your library for a blue instant card, reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: Search your library for a blue instant card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Witch of the Moors
lines: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained life this turn, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice and you return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no intervening-if condition for 'you gained life this turn' (the only life condition reads a life total or an opponent's life loss).

cards.name: Urabrask's Forge
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put an oil counter on this artifact, then create an X/1 red Phyrexian Horror creature token with trample and haste, where X is the number of oil counters on this artifact. Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no way to sacrifice the token created by this trigger at the beginning of the next end step: createToken has no sacrifice-at-end-step option (only createTokenCopyOf has sacrificeAt), and a delayed sacrifice of the created token has no op that names it.

cards.name: Mnemonic Betrayal
lines: Exile all opponents' graveyards. You may cast spells from among those cards this turn, and mana of any type can be spent to cast them. At the beginning of the next end step, if any of those cards remain exiled, return them to their owners' graveyards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect lets you cast cards exiled from opponents' graveyards this turn with mana of any type and then returns the uncast ones to their owners' graveyards at the next end step.

cards.name: Oath of Teferi
lines: You may activate the loyalty abilities of planeswalkers you control twice each turn rather than only once.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No static or rule modifier lets its controller activate loyalty abilities more than once per turn.

cards.name: Siege-Gang Lieutenant
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control your commander, create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens. Those tokens gain haste until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your combat, if you control your commander, create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens. Each of them has haste until end of turn.

cards.name: The Earth King
lines: Whenever one or more creatures you control with power 4 or greater attack, search your library for up to that many basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you declare attackers, if one or more creatures you control with power 4 or greater are attacking, search your library for a number of basic land cards equal to the trigger's count, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. The search may find fewer cards than that number.

cards.name: Protean Hulk
lines: When this creature dies, search your library for any number of creature cards with total mana value 6 or less, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No search finds any number of creature cards limited by a total mana value; the mana-value limit applies to each card separately.

cards.name: The Mindskinner
lines: If a source you control would deal damage to an opponent, prevent that damage and each opponent mills that many cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No damage-prevention static redirects a source's damage to opponents into each opponent milling that many cards.

cards.name: Fangs of Kalonia
lines: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control, then double the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature that had a +1/+1 counter put on it this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The overload mode (each creature you control instead of target creature you control) would need its own alternative ability, and the parsed overload cast has none to carry it, so the single-target half cannot be attached without mis-modeling the overload cast.

cards.name: Dionus, Elvish Archdruid
lines: Elves you control have "Whenever this creature becomes tapped during your turn, untap it and put a +1/+1 counter on it. This ability triggers only once each turn."
cards.backTranslation: Each Elf you control has "Whenever this creature becomes tapped, untap it and put a +1/+1 counter on it. This ability triggers only once each turn, and only during your turn."

cards.name: Dawnsire, Sunstar Dreadnought
lines: 10+ | Whenever you attack, ~ deals 100 damage to up to one target creature or planeswalker.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you attack, if this has ten or more charge counters on it, choose up to one target creature or planeswalker. This deals 100 damage to each target chosen this way.

cards.name: Baird, Steward of Argive
lines: Creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control unless their controller pays {1} for each of those creatures.
cards.backTranslation: Each creature that attacks requires its controller to pay {1} for each attacking creature. This applies to attacks on planeswalkers as well.
differences: Text A restricts the tax to creatures attacking you or planeswalkers you control; Text B applies the {1} payment to every attacking creature, including attacks on other players or planeswalkers that are not yours.

cards.name: Tempt with Vengeance
lines: Create X 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens with haste. Each opponent may create X 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens with haste. For each opponent who does, create X 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens with haste.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema's opponent-token effects (eachOpponentCreatesTokens, shareTokensWithChosenOpponent) do not model each opponent's separate 'may' choice that sets whether the controller also creates X tokens for that opponent.

cards.name: Momentous Fall
lines: You draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power, then you gain life equal to its toughness.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no value for the power or toughness of the creature sacrificed as the additional cost, so the draw count and life gain cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Zack Fair
lines: {1}, Sacrifice ~: Target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn. Put ~'s counters on that creature and attach an Equipment that was attached to ~ to that creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect op attaches an Equipment that was attached to the sacrificed source onto another creature; attachSelfTo only equips the ability's own source.

cards.name: Giada, Font of Hope
lines: Each other Angel you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it for each Angel you already control.
cards.backTranslation: Each other Angel you control enters the battlefield with a number of additional +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of Angels you control.

cards.name: Kellogg, Dangerous Mind
lines: Sacrifice five Treasures: Gain control of target creature for as long as you control ~. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The control change lasts as long as you control Kellogg, but gainControlTarget's durations end with the source leaving the battlefield (whileSourceOnBattlefield), so it would not end if an opponent gained control of Kellogg while it stayed on the battlefield.

cards.name: Nature's Will
lines: Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, tap all lands that player controls and untap all lands you control.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, tap each land that player controls and untap each land you control.

cards.name: Artifact Mutation
lines: Destroy target artifact. It can't be regenerated. Create X 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens, where X is that artifact's mana value.
cards.backTranslation:
Create a number of 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens equal to the mana value of target artifact.
Destroy that artifact. It can't be regenerated.

cards.name: Beamtown Beatstick
lines: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player or battle, create a Treasure token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The trigger set has no event for combat damage dealt to a battle, so the 'or battle' half of the Treasure trigger cannot be stated.

cards.name: Alandra, Sky Dreamer
lines: Whenever you draw your fifth card each turn, ~ and Drakes you control each get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards in your hand.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you draw your fifth card each turn, this creature and each Drake you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards in your hand that are artifact, battle, creature, enchantment, instant, land, planeswalker, or sorcery cards.

cards.name: Giant Adephage
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a token that's a copy of this creature.

cards.name: Angrath's Marauders
lines: If a source you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals double that damage to that permanent or player instead.
cards.backTranslation: If a source you control would deal damage, it deals double that damage instead.

cards.name: Planar Nexus
lines: ~ is every nonbasic land type.
cards.backTranslation: This land is a Cave, Desert, Gate, Lair, Locus, Mine, Power-Plant, Sphere, Tower, and Urza's in addition to its other types.

cards.name: Gold-Forged Thopteryx
lines: Each legendary permanent you control has ward {2}.
cards.backTranslation: Legendary permanents you control have ward {2}.

cards.name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
lines: {B}, {T}, Sacrifice another creature: Create X 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens, where X is the sacrificed creature's power.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The token count is the power of the creature sacrificed as a cost, and no Value reads the power of a permanent sacrificed as a cost (stationPower covers only Station taps).

cards.name: Linvala, Keeper of Silence
lines: Activated abilities of creatures your opponents control can't be activated.
cards.backTranslation: Your opponents can't activate abilities of creatures they control. This applies on every turn, not only yours.

cards.name: Brass Squire
lines: {T}: Attach target Equipment you control to target creature you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect attaches a targeted Equipment that is not the source to a targeted creature; attachSelfTo moves only the source and attach moves only a trigger object.

cards.name: Scholar of New Horizons
lines: {T}, Remove a counter from a permanent you control: Search your library for a Plains card and reveal it. If an opponent controls more lands than you, you may put that card onto the battlefield tapped. If you don't put the card onto the battlefield, put it into your hand. Then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cost removes a counter of any kind from any permanent you control, and removeCountersFromAmong requires one named counter kind.

cards.name: Soul's Fire
lines: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to any target.
cards.backTranslation: Choose a creature you control and any target. The creature you control deals damage equal to its power to the chosen target. (The creature you control is the source of that damage.)

cards.name: Wrathful Raptors
lines: Whenever a Dinosaur you control is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to any target that isn't a Dinosaur.
validatorIssues: override.def.triggers[0].targets[0]: target filter is not implemented for every member of this domain
cards.inexpressibleReason: An 'anyTarget' slot cannot carry a 'not a Dinosaur' filter: the validator rejects target filters on player/anyTarget domains, so 'any target that isn't a Dinosaur' cannot be said exactly.

cards.name: Great Divide Guide
lines: Each land and Ally you control has "{T}: Add one mana of any color."
cards.backTranslation: Lands you control and Allies you control have "{T}: Add one mana of any color."

cards.name: Ascend from Avernus
lines: Return all creature and planeswalker cards with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Exile ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The mana value bound is X, but manaValueAtMost takes a fixed number and graveyardToBattlefieldEach has no X-valued bound, so 'mana value X or less' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Gateway Plaza
lines: When this land enters, sacrifice it unless you pay {1}.
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, sacrifice it unless you pay {1}.

cards.name: Final Parting
lines: Search your library for two cards. Put one into your hand and the other into your graveyard. Then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: Search your library for two cards with no restriction, put them into your hand or your graveyard, then shuffle.
differences: Text A requires one card to go to hand and the other to the graveyard; Text B allows both cards to go to the hand or both to the graveyard (put them into your hand or your graveyard with no split required).

cards.name: Ancient Bronze Dragon
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. When you do, put X +1/+1 counters on each of up to two target creatures, where X is the result.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no die-roll effect, so the result X of "roll a d20" cannot be expressed as the counter count in the "When you do" reflexive trigger.

cards.name: Bite Down
lines: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.
cards.backTranslation: Choose a creature you control and a creature or planeswalker an opponent controls. The creature you control deals damage equal to its power to the chosen creature or planeswalker the opponent controls.

cards.name: Jeskai Ascendancy
lines: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. Untap those creatures.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, each creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Untap each creature you control.

cards.name: Aettir and Priwen
lines: Equipped creature has base power and toughness X/X, where X is your life total.
cards.backTranslation: Equipped creature has base power and toughness each equal to your life total.

cards.name: Temporal Mastery
lines: Miracle {1}{U}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Miracle is an alternative cost that is offered only when this card is the first card drawn this turn, and the schema has no miracle alternative cast or draw-timing condition.

cards.name: Cunning Rhetoric
lines: Whenever an opponent attacks you and/or one or more planeswalkers you control, exile the top card of that player's library. You may play that card for as long as it remains exiled, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The card is exiled face up and may be played for as long as it remains exiled, but exileLibraryTop's cast grant lasts only until end of turn and no op grants a permanent play permission for a face-up exiled card.

cards.name: Worldsoul's Rage
lines: ~ deals X damage to any target. Put up to X land cards from your hand and/or graveyard onto the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect puts up to X land cards from hand and/or graveyard onto the battlefield tapped: handToBattlefield is hand-only and the graveyard-to-battlefield ops are neither land-filtered nor count-limited.

cards.name: Torrential Gearhulk
lines: When this creature enters, you may cast target instant card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op casts a targeted instant card from the graveyard without paying its mana cost with the 'exile it instead' replacement.

cards.name: Cursed Totem
lines: Activated abilities of creatures can't be activated.
cards.backTranslation: Activated abilities of creatures can't be activated, by any player, at any time.

cards.name: Zenith Chronicler
lines: Whenever a player casts their first multicolored spell each turn, each other player draws a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The castsSpell filter has no 'multicolored' selector (isMonocolored would also match colorless spells), so 'first multicolored spell each turn' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Flesh Duplicate
lines: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it has vanishing 3 if that creature doesn't have vanishing.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The copy's extra keyword is conditional on whether the copied creature has vanishing, and the schema has no condition over the copied creature's keywords and no vanishing keyword to grant (vanishing 3 is not in IMPLEMENTED_KEYWORDS).

cards.name: Teferi's Time Twist
lines: Exile target permanent you control. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step. If it enters as a creature, it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The extra +1/+1 counter applies only if the returned card enters as a creature, and the delayed return (exileTargetReturnAtNextEndStep) has no way to add a counter conditioned on the returned object being a creature.

cards.name: Step Through
lines: Return two target creatures to their owners' hands.
cards.backTranslation: Choose two target creatures, the second different from the first. Return each of them to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Fire Covenant
lines: ~ deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures.
validatorIssues: override.def.spellAbility.targets[0].count: target count must have integer bounds with 0 <= min <= max
cards.backTranslation: Choose any number of target creatures. Fire Covenant deals X damage divided as you choose among them.

cards.name: Murkfiend Liege
lines: Untap all green and/or blue creatures you control during each other player's untap step.
cards.backTranslation: Each green or blue creature, whoever controls it, untaps during each other player's untap step.
differences: Text A untaps only green and/or blue creatures you control; Text B untaps green or blue creatures regardless of who controls them.

cards.name: Volatile Fault
lines: {1}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Destroy target nonbasic land an opponent controls. That player may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. You create a Treasure token.
cards.backTranslation: {1}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Destroy target nonbasic land an opponent controls. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield untapped. Create a colorless Treasure artifact token with "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color."
differences: Text A says the player may search, put the basic land onto the battlefield, then shuffle; Text B omits the shuffle, so the library is not shuffled after the search.

cards.name: Genesis Hydra
lines: When you cast this spell, reveal the top X cards of your library. You may put a nonland permanent card with mana value X or less from among them onto the battlefield. Then shuffle the rest into your library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cast trigger's look-at-top-X put-onto-battlefield pick cannot cap the permanent's mana value at X (lookAtTopN.mayPut has no mana-value limit), and its remaining cards cannot be shuffled into the library (lookAtTopN.rest offers only bottom or graveyard).

cards.name: Cosmos Elixir
lines: At the beginning of your end step, draw a card if your life total is greater than your starting life total. Otherwise, you gain 2 life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no starting-life-total value, and the life comparison can only be made against a constant, which would approximate the rule.

cards.name: Heroes' Podium
lines: {X}, {T}: Look at the top X cards of your library. You may reveal a legendary creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The look-at count is the announced X of the {X} activation cost, but lookAtTopN takes only a fixed number for its count, so the number of cards looked at cannot be the announced X.

cards.name: Vat of Rebirth
lines: Whenever another artifact or creature you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put an oil counter on this artifact.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever another artifact or creature you control leaves the battlefield and is put into a graveyard, put an oil counter on this artifact.

cards.name: Tectonic Hazard
lines: ~ deals 1 damage to each opponent and each creature they control.
cards.backTranslation: This spell deals 1 damage to each opponent and 1 damage to each creature an opponent controls.

cards.name: Blood Seeker
lines: Whenever a creature an opponent controls enters, you may have that player lose 1 life.
validatorIssues: override.def.triggers[0].effects[0].target: event player reference has no owning event player scope
cards.inexpressibleReason: An 'enters' trigger provides no event player, so 'that player' (the controller of the entering creature) cannot be referenced for the life loss.

cards.name: Sword of War and Peace
lines: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, this Equipment deals damage to that player equal to the number of cards in their hand and you gain 1 life for each card in your hand.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever the equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, this deals damage to that player equal to the number of cards in that player's hand, and you gain life equal to the number of cards in your hand.

cards.name: Estrid's Invocation
lines: You may have this enchantment enter as a copy of an enchantment you control, except it has "At the beginning of your upkeep, you may exile this enchantment. If you do, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control."
cards.backTranslation: As this enters, it becomes a copy of an enchantment you control and gains the following ability: "At the beginning of your upkeep, you may exile this and then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control."
differences: Text A says "you may" have the enchantment enter as a copy (optional); Text B says it always becomes a copy as it enters (mandatory).

cards.name: Reckless Handling
lines: Search your library for an artifact card, reveal it, put it into your hand, shuffle, then discard a card at random. If an artifact card was discarded this way, ~ deals 2 damage to each opponent.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The discard-at-random branch has no condition on the type of the card discarded, so 'if an artifact card was discarded this way' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Gilded Drake
lines: When this creature enters, exchange control of this creature and up to one target creature an opponent controls. If you don't or can't make an exchange, sacrifice this creature. This ability still resolves if its target becomes illegal.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no exchange-control effect (swapping control of this creature and a chosen opponent creature), and the swap-or-sacrifice fallback depends on it.

cards.name: Semester's End
lines: Exile any number of target creatures and/or planeswalkers you control. At the beginning of the next end step, return each of them to the battlefield under its owner's control. Each of them enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it if it's a creature and an additional loyalty counter on it if it's a planeswalker.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A variable set of chosen creatures and planeswalkers must each return at the next end step with a +1/+1 or loyalty counter on entry, and no delayed-return effect covers a chosen set with per-object counters.

cards.name: Nalfeshnee
lines: Whenever you cast a spell from exile, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy. If it's a permanent spell, the copy gains haste and "At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this permanent."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The castsSpell trigger's castFrom field can name graveyard, hand or 'notHand' but not exile, and 'notHand' would also match library and command-zone casts.

cards.name: Raise the Past
lines: Return all creature cards with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: Return each creature card with mana value 2 or less in your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: Lich-Knights' Conquest
lines: Sacrifice any number of artifacts, enchantments, and/or tokens. Return that many creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no 'sacrifice any number of artifacts, enchantments, and/or tokens' choice whose chosen count then sets how many creature cards return from the graveyard (sacrificeOther takes only a fixed count).

cards.name: Shimmer Dragon
lines: As long as you control four or more artifacts, this creature has hexproof.
cards.backTranslation: This creature has hexproof as long as you control four or more artifacts.

cards.name: Traumatize
lines: Target player mills half their library, rounded down.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value gives half of a player's library size rounded down, and millTargetPlayer takes only a fixed count.

cards.name: Khalni Heart Expedition
lines: Remove three quest counters from this enchantment and sacrifice it: Search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: Remove three quest counters from this and sacrifice this: Search your library for two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
differences: Text A searches for up to two basic land cards, so zero or one may be found; Text B says two basic land cards, which requires exactly two.

cards.name: Boseiju, Who Shelters All
lines: {T}, Pay 2 life: Add {C}. If that mana is spent on an instant or sorcery spell, that spell can't be countered.
cards.inexpressibleReason: uncounterableSpell cannot be limited to spells paid for with this mana without also restricting the mana to instant and sorcery spells, which the line does not do.

cards.name: Domri, Anarch of Bolas
lines: +1: Add {R} or {G}. Creature spells you cast this turn can't be countered.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect makes the creature spells you cast this turn uncounterable until end of turn.

cards.name: Hyena Umbra
lines: Umbra armor
cards.inexpressibleReason: Umbra armor is a replacement on the enchanted creature's destruction (remove all damage and destroy this Aura instead), and the schema has no static destruction-replacement rule to express it.

cards.name: Cloudstone Curio
lines: Whenever a nonartifact permanent you control enters, you may return another permanent you control that shares a permanent type with it to its owner's hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No selector matches a permanent that shares a permanent type with the entering trigger object, so 'another permanent that shares a permanent type with it' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Valkyrie Harbinger
lines: At the beginning of each end step, if you gained 4 or more life this turn, create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying and vigilance.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The intervening-if asks whether you gained 4 or more life this turn, and no Condition or Value counts life gained this turn (lifeTotal reads current life, not life gained).

cards.name: Clifftop Lookout
lines: When this creature enters, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card. Put that card onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect op reveals cards from the top of the library until a land is revealed and then puts that card onto the battlefield tapped; lookAtTopN takes a fixed count.

cards.name: Settle the Wreckage
lines: Exile all attacking creatures target player controls. That player may search their library for that many basic land cards, put those cards onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot select the attacking creatures controlled by the targeted player to exile, and cannot count the exiled creatures for the "that many" basic-land search.

cards.name: Inspired Tinkering
lines: Exile the top three cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The exiled cards must stay playable until the end of your next turn, but exileTopNPlayableUntilEot grants play only until the end of this turn, and no exile op grants a longer window.

cards.name: Expel the Interlopers
lines: Choose a number between 0 and 10. Destroy all creatures with power greater than or equal to the chosen number.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no "choose a number between 0 and 10" choice that a destroy-by-power effect can read back, so the chosen threshold cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Infectious Bite
lines: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control. Each opponent gets a poison counter.
cards.backTranslation: Choose a target creature you control and a target creature an opponent controls. The creature you control deals damage equal to its power to the creature an opponent controls. Each opponent gets a poison counter.

cards.name: River of Tears
lines: {T}: Add {U}. If you played a land this turn, add {B} instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The "If you played a land this turn, add {B} instead" branch needs a condition on whether the controller played a land this turn, and the Condition schema has no such leaf.

cards.name: Troll of Khazad-dûm
lines: ~ can't be blocked except by three or more creatures.
cards.backTranslation: This creature can't be blocked except by three or more creatures.

cards.name: Bone Shards
lines: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or discard a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The additional cost is a choice between sacrificing a creature and discarding a card, but spellAdditionalCosts requires every listed cost to be paid, and no disjunctive cost exists.

cards.name: Scythecat Cub
lines: Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, double the number of +1/+1 counters on that creature instead.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a land you control enters, target creature you control. Under a hidden key, count how many times this ability has resolved this turn, including this resolution. If that count is 2, put a number of +1/+1 counters on that creature equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

cards.name: Kaervek the Merciless
lines: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, ~ deals damage equal to that spell's mana value to any target.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, choose any target. Deal damage equal to that spell's mana value to that target.

cards.name: Vein Ripper
lines: Ward—Sacrifice a creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Ward—Sacrifice a creature is a sacrifice cost, and WardCost only allows a mana cost or a life payment.

cards.name: Inquisitive Glimmer
lines: Unlock costs you pay cost {1} less.
cards.inexpressibleReason: costReduction applies only to casting spells or activating abilities, and no reduction kind applies to unlock costs (Room doors).

cards.name: Sundial of the Infinite
lines: {1}, {T}: End the turn. Activate only during your turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Ending the turn (exiling everything on the stack, discarding to hand size, and ending this-turn and until-end-of-turn effects) has no effect in the schema.

cards.name: Ethersworn Canonist
lines: Each player who has cast a nonartifact spell this turn can't cast additional nonartifact spells.
cards.inexpressibleReason: spellCastLimit only counts 'any' or 'noncreature' spells, so the 'nonartifact spell' category that this static limits per player cannot be stated.

cards.name: Urza's Bauble
lines: {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Look at a card at random in target player's hand. You draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect op lets the controller look at a random card in a target player's hand.

cards.name: Double Vision
lines: Whenever you cast your first instant or sorcery spell each turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The trigger's ordinal counts every spell you cast, not only instant and sorcery spells, so 'your first instant or sorcery spell each turn' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Fated Firepower
lines: If a source you control would deal damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus an amount of damage equal to the number of fire counters on this enchantment instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema's damage replacements only double or halve damage (damageDoubled, damageDoubledToOpponents, damageHalvedToYou); none adds a fixed-count fire-counter amount to each damage event.

cards.name: Raging Ravine
lines: {2}{R}{G}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 3/3 red and green Elemental creature with "Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on it." It's still a land.
cards.backTranslation: {2}{R}{G}: This land becomes a 3/3 red and green Elemental creature until end of turn. It gains "Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on it." until end of turn.

cards.name: Quietus Spike
lines: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, that player loses half their life, rounded up.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever the equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, that player loses half their life.
differences: Text A makes the player lose half their life rounded up; Text B has no rounding instruction, so the amount is unspecified for odd life totals.

cards.name: Repulsive Mutation
lines: Put X +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. Then counter up to one target spell unless its controller pays mana equal to the greatest power among creatures you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The counter-unless payment is the state-derived greatest power among creatures you control, but counterUnlessControllerPays takes only a fixed ParsedManaCost.

cards.name: The Unagi of Kyoshi Island
lines: Ward—Waterbend {4}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: WardCost is only a mana or life payment, so the Waterbend ward's option for the opponent to tap their artifacts and creatures to help pay each {1} cannot be stated.

cards.name: Persistent Constrictor
lines: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, they lose 1 life and you put a -1/-1 counter on up to one target creature they control.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, that opponent loses 1 life. Up to one target creature that opponent controls is chosen when this ability is put on the stack. Put a -1/-1 counter on each creature chosen this way.

cards.name: Volrath's Stronghold
lines: {1}{B}, {T}: Put target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library.
cards.backTranslation: {1}{B}, {T}: Put target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library.

cards.name: Overgrown Battlement
lines: {T}: Add {G} for each creature you control with defender.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Counting creatures you control with defender needs a keyword selector, but hasKeyword is event-only in the schema and cannot be read by a mana ability's amount.

cards.name: Meekstone
lines: Creatures with power 3 or greater don't untap during their controllers' untap steps.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No static effect can stop other creatures from untapping during their controllers' untap steps; doesntUntapDuringUntapStep applies only to the card itself.

cards.name: Tishana's Tidebinder
lines: When this creature enters, counter up to one target activated or triggered ability. If an ability of an artifact, creature, or planeswalker is countered this way, that permanent loses all abilities for as long as this creature remains on the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The target is an activated or triggered ability, but a stackObject target slot takes only one stackKind, so it cannot name both kinds, and the lost-abilities effect lasts only while Tishana's Tidebinder remains on the battlefield, which no effect expresses.

cards.name: Keen Sense
lines: Whenever enchanted creature deals damage to an opponent, you may draw a card.
validatorIssues: override.def.triggers[0].trigger.subject: opponent damage currently supports only the damaging source's own ability
cards.inexpressibleReason: The dealsDamageToOpponent trigger only supports the damaging source itself as subject, and a trigger granted to the enchanted creature would belong to that creature's controller rather than the Aura's controller ('you may draw').

cards.name: Unholy Grotto
lines: {B}, {T}: Put target Zombie card from your graveyard on top of your library.
cards.backTranslation: {B}, {T}: Put target Zombie card from your graveyard on top of your library.

cards.name: Thalisse, Reverent Medium
lines: At the beginning of each end step, create X 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying, where X is the number of tokens you created this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No value counts the tokens you created this turn, so the X in the end-step token trigger cannot be stated.

cards.name: Brokers Ascendancy
lines: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control and a loyalty counter on each planeswalker you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The loyalty counter on each planeswalker needs a counter name for loyalty, and the schema documents no name for loyalty counters, so the planeswalker half cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Sacrifice
lines: Add an amount of {B} equal to the sacrificed creature's mana value.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value reads the mana value of the creature sacrificed as an additional cost of a spell (amountFromSacrificedManaValue exists only on mana abilities), so the amount of {B} added on resolution cannot be stated.

cards.name: Genesis Chamber
lines: Whenever a nontoken creature enters, if this artifact is untapped, that creature's controller creates a 1/1 colorless Myr artifact creature token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema defines the creature's controller as the event player only for dies triggers (subjectControllerIsEventPlayer), so 'that creature's controller creates a token' on an enters trigger cannot be stated with a documented player reference.

cards.name: Nykthos Paragon
lines: Whenever you gain life, you may put that many +1/+1 counters on each creature you control. Do this only once each turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A gainsLife trigger carries no amount of life gained, so 'that many +1/+1 counters' cannot be read, and the schema has no once-each-turn flag on gainsLife.

cards.name: Reyav, Master Smith
lines: Whenever a creature you control that's enchanted or equipped attacks, that creature gains double strike until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature you control that is enchanted or equipped attacks, that creature gains double strike until end of turn.

cards.name: Jumbo Cactuar
lines: 10,000 Needles — Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +9999/+0 until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +9999/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Drift of Phantasms
lines: Transmute {1}{U}{U}
cards.backTranslation: {1}{U}{U}, Discard this card: Search your library for a card with mana value 3, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery and only while this card is in your hand.
differences: Text A searches for a card with the same mana value as this card; Text B hard-codes mana value 3, so the searched mana value is not tied to this card in B and the two match only if this card's mana value is 3, which neither text states.

cards.name: Pyromancer's Goggles
lines: {T}: Add {R}. When that mana is spent to cast a red instant or sorcery spell, copy that spell and you may choose new targets for the copy.
cards.backTranslation:
{T}: Add {R}.
Whenever this mana is spent to cast a red instant or sorcery spell, copy that spell.
differences: Text A lets the controller choose new targets for the copy ('you may choose new targets for the copy'); Text B omits this, so the copy keeps the original spell's targets.

cards.name: Price of Progress
lines: ~ deals damage to each player equal to twice the number of nonbasic lands that player controls.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op deals each player damage equal to twice that player's own nonbasic land count: dealDamageNonbasicLands targets a single player and takes no multiplier, and damageEachPlayer uses one amount for every player.

cards.name: Archetype of Aggression
lines: Creatures your opponents control lose trample and can't have or gain trample.
cards.backTranslation: Creatures your opponents control can't have trample.
differences: Text A makes creatures your opponents control lose trample (removing it from ones that have it) as well as preventing them from having or gaining it; Text B only prevents them from having trample, so existing trample is not removed.

cards.name: Alseid of Life's Bounty
lines: {1}, Sacrifice this creature: Target creature or enchantment you control gains protection from the color of your choice until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: {1}, Sacrifice this: Target creature or enchantment you control gains protection from the chosen color until end of turn.

cards.name: Sanctum of Ugin
lines: Whenever you cast a colorless spell with mana value 7 or greater, you may sacrifice this land. If you do, search your library for a colorless creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No selector matches colorless spells or colorless creature cards, so the 'colorless spell with mana value 7 or greater' trigger and the colorless creature search cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Vorpal Sword
lines: {5}{B}{B}{B}: Until end of turn, this Equipment gains "Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, that player loses the game."
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect makes a player lose the game, which the granted 'that player loses the game' trigger requires.

cards.name: Sulfuric Vortex
lines: If a player would gain life, that player gains no life instead.

lines: Suspend 2—{1}{W}

cards.inexpressibleReason: No static lets opponents' creatures be targeted as though they lacked hexproof, and no effect suppresses their ward triggers.

When this enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

cards.name: Pariah
lines: All damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to enchanted creature instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect redirects damage dealt to you onto the enchanted creature.

cards.backTranslation: Whenever an opponent casts the first noncreature spell, recruit.

cards.name: Beacon of Immortality
lines: Double target player's life total. Shuffle ~ into its owner's library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Doubling a target player's life total needs a life-total Value read from an announced target, but lifeTotal only reads 'you' or the event player.

cards.name: Gwenom, Remorseless
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, until end of turn, you may look at the top card of your library any time and you may play cards from the top of your library. If you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than pay its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The look-at-top and play-from-top permission lasts only until end of turn once Gwenom attacks, but the schema grants a top-of-library cast or play permission only as a static ruleStatic that lasts while the source is on the battlefield, and grantAbilityUntilEot cannot carry ruleStatics.

cards.name: Paradox Haze
lines: At the beginning of enchanted player's first upkeep each turn, that player gets an additional upkeep step after this step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect grants an additional upkeep step to a player during the upkeep.

cards.name: Bitter Reunion
lines: When this enchantment enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw two cards.
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, you may discard two cards. If you do, draw two cards.
differences: Text A has the player discard a card (one card) before drawing two; Text B has the player discard two cards before drawing two.

cards.name: Hell to Pay
lines: ~ deals X damage to target creature. Create a number of tapped Treasure tokens equal to the amount of excess damage dealt to that creature this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Treasure count is the excess damage dealt to the creature (damage beyond its toughness), and no Value reads excess damage from a dealDamage effect.

cards.name: Shadow Rift
lines: Target creature gains shadow until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Shadow is not in the keyword list, so grantKeywordUntilEot cannot grant it.

cards.name: Finale of Glory
lines: Create X 2/2 white Soldier creature tokens with vigilance. If X is 10 or more, also create X 4/4 white Angel creature tokens with flying and vigilance.

Create X 2/2 white Soldier creature tokens with vigilance.
If X is 10 or more, create X 4/4 white Angel creature tokens with flying and vigilance.

cards.name: Imoti, Celebrant of Bounty
lines: Spells you cast with mana value 6 or greater have cascade.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No static effect can grant the cascade keyword to spells you cast by mana value; keywords exist only on a card's own definition.

cards.name: Geode Rager
lines: Whenever a land you control enters, goad each creature target player controls.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect goads each creature a targeted player controls; goad takes a single target and goadEachOpponent covers only opponents.

cards.name: Basilisk Gate
lines: {2}, {T}: Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of Gates you control. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Cackling Counterpart
lines: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control.
cards.backTranslation: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control.

cards.name: Revenge of Ravens
lines: Whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, that creature's controller loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature an opponent controls attacks you, that creature's controller loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
differences: Text A triggers on a creature attacking you or a planeswalker you control; Text B triggers only on a creature an opponent controls attacking you, so attacks on your planeswalkers are missing from B.

cards.name: Fraying Sanity
lines: At the beginning of each end step, enchanted player mills X cards, where X is the number of cards put into their graveyard from anywhere this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The mill count is the number of cards put into graveyards from anywhere this turn, and no Value counts that (countCardsInZone reads current zone contents, not cards that entered this turn).

cards.name: Shoreline Looter
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card. Then discard a card unless there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card. Then if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, nothing happens. Otherwise, discard a card.

cards.name: Rionya, Fire Dancer
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create X tokens that are copies of another target creature you control, where X is one plus the number of instant and sorcery spells you've cast this turn. They gain haste. Exile them at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: X counts only instant and sorcery spells cast this turn, but the only spell-count value counts all spells, and the tokens must be exiled at the next end step, which only sacrificeAt (a sacrifice) can express.

cards.name: Collective Inferno
lines: Double all damage that sources you control of the chosen type would deal.
cards.backTranslation: If a source you control of the chosen creature type would deal damage, it deals double that damage instead.

cards.name: Inspiring Leader
lines: Commander creatures you own have "Creature tokens you control get +2/+2."
cards.inexpressibleReason: No continuous op grants a static effect to other objects; layer 6 grants only keywords, triggers, activated abilities and mana abilities, so 'creature tokens you control get +2/+2' cannot be granted.

cards.name: Magewright's Stone
lines: {1}, {T}: Untap target creature that has an activated ability with {T} in its cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The target restriction 'creature that has an activated ability with {T} in its cost' has no selector or target filter in the schema (no selector reads a creature's abilities or tap-cost abilities).

cards.name: Wolverine Riders
lines: Whenever another Elf you control enters, you gain life equal to its toughness.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value reads the toughness of the entering creature that fired the trigger, so the life gained cannot be stated.

cards.name: Foundation Breaker
lines: Evoke {1}{G}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Evoke is an alternative mana cost with a sacrifice-on-entry rider, and no alternativeCasts kind or condition in the schema represents it.

cards.name: Cornered by Black Mages
lines: Target opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The target must be an opponent, and the player target kind has no opponent-only restriction (TargetSpec.controller is documented only for permanents), so "target opponent" cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Umezawa's Jitte
lines: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage, put two charge counters on ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The only combat-damage trigger for the equipped creature is dealsCombatDamageToPlayer, which misses combat damage dealt to creatures, and no trigger head covers an attached creature dealing combat damage to any object.

cards.name: Summer Bloom
lines: You may play up to three additional lands this turn.
cards.backTranslation: You can play three additional lands this turn.
differences: Text A lets the player play up to three additional lands (zero to three, optional); Text B says the player can play exactly three additional lands.

cards.name: Greensleeves, Maro-Sorcerer
lines: Protection from planeswalkers and from Wizards
cards.inexpressibleReason: ProtectionQuality only covers colors, 'multicolored' and 'creatures', so 'protection from planeswalkers and from Wizards' (a card type and a creature subtype) cannot be stated.

cards.name: Celestine, the Living Saint
lines: Healing Tears — At the beginning of your end step, return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No count reads the life you gained this turn, and the mana-value filter takes only a fixed number rather than the value X.

cards.name: Herald of War
lines: Angel spells and Human spells you cast cost {1} less to cast for each +1/+1 counter on this creature.
cards.backTranslation: Spells you cast that are Angel spells or Human spells cost {1} less to cast for each +1/+1 counter on this.

cards.name: Ancestral Vision
lines: Suspend 4—{U}
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no suspend keyword or alternative cast for Suspend 4—{U} (exile with time counters, then cast without paying the mana cost when the last is removed).

cards.name: Machine God's Effigy
lines: You may have this artifact enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it's an artifact and it has "{T}: Add {U}."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The entersAsCopy shape can add types but cannot remove the creature type or grant the copy the {T}: Add {U} mana ability, so 'it's an artifact and not a creature, with the granted mana ability' cannot be written.

cards.name: Daze
lines: You may return an Island you control to its owner's hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The alternative cost 'return an Island you control to its owner's hand' has no AbilityCost kind for returning a controlled permanent to hand (sacrificeOther and tapOther do not return it).

cards.name: Rampaging Yao Guai
lines: When this creature enters, destroy any number of target artifacts and/or enchantments with total mana value X or less.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A target slot's totalManaValueAtMost is a fixed number, so 'total mana value X or less' for any number of artifacts and/or enchantments cannot use the creature's X.

cards.name: Legion Loyalty
lines: Creatures you control have myriad.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Myriad is not a KeywordAbility in the schema, so creatures you control cannot be granted it.

cards.name: Maze's End
lines: {3}, {T}, Return this land to its owner's hand: Search your library for a Gate card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. If you control ten or more Gates with different names, you win the game.
cards.inexpressibleReason: AbilityCost has no cost that returns this land to its owner's hand as part of an activation.

cards.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
lines: Each opponent exiles cards from the top of their library until that player has exiled cards with total mana value 20 or greater.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op exiles cards from a library until their total mana value reaches a threshold.

cards.name: Winter Moon
lines: Players can't untap more than one nonbasic land during their untap steps.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No rule static limits how many nonbasic lands players may untap during their untap steps; the untap-limit ruleStatics do not cover this.

cards.name: Planar Engineering
lines: Sacrifice two lands. Search your library for four basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation:
Sacrifice a land you control.
Sacrifice a land you control.
Search your library for four basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

cards.name: Oakhollow Village
lines: {G}, {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each Frog, Rabbit, Raccoon, or Squirrel you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
cards.backTranslation: {G}, {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that entered the battlefield this turn and is a Frog, Rabbit, Raccoon, or Squirrel.

cards.name: Royal Treatment
lines: Target creature you control gains hexproof until end of turn. Create a Royal Role token attached to that creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Role token can be spec'd, but the rule that a second Role on the same creature is put into the graveyard has no schema form, so the attached Role would not follow the printed rules.

cards.inexpressibleReason: A target slot's count is a fixed min/max, not a value equal to X, and each chosen permanent must be copied X times, which no effect expresses.

cards.name: Brago, King Eternal
lines: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, exile any number of target nonland permanents you control, then return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Exile any number of target nonland permanents you control' needs an unbounded target count, and TargetSpec.count requires a finite max.

cards.name: Uncivil Unrest
lines: If a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals double that damage instead.
cards.backTranslation: If a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it would deal damage, that damage is doubled.

cards.name: Kona, Rescue Beastie
lines: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if ~ is tapped, you may put a permanent card from your hand onto the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is not untapped, you may put an artifact, creature, enchantment, land, or planeswalker card from your hand onto the battlefield.
differences: Text A lets you put any permanent card from hand onto the battlefield; Text B lists artifact, creature, enchantment, land, or planeswalker cards and omits battle cards, which are permanent cards.

cards.name: Lightning, Army of One
lines: Stagger — Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, until your next turn, if a source would deal damage to that player or a permanent that player controls, it deals double that damage instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect makes a duration-limited ('until your next turn') damage doubling keyed to the player just dealt combat damage; damageDoubled and damageDoubledToOpponents last while the card is on the battlefield.

cards.name: Overlord of the Floodpits
lines: Impending 4—{1}{U}{U}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Impending needs an alternative cast that enters with four time counters, is not a creature while any remain, and loses one at each of your end steps; the schema has no time-counter lifecycle or not-a-creature-while-counters state to express it.

lines: {T}, Pay 3 life: Add {C}. If that mana is spent on a creature spell, it gains haste.

cards.name: Spectacular Spider-Man
