cards.backTranslation: {1}: This creature gains flying until end of turn.

cards.inexpressibleReason: The only entering-caused trigger doubler is limited to artifact or creature entries, and triggerAdditionalTime has no entering-cause condition, so it would double all triggers of your permanents.

lines: Sacrifice a Food: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature attacks, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of other permanents you control that are Squirrels, Bats, Lizards, or Rats.
differences: Text A is the ability 'Sacrifice a Food: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield'; Text B describes a different ability, an attack trigger that drains based on other Squirrels, Bats, Lizards, or Rats, and does not contain the graveyard return ability at all.

cards.name: Blowfly Infestation
lines: Whenever a creature dies, if it had a -1/-1 counter on it, put a -1/-1 counter on target creature.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature that has a -1/-1 counter on it dies, put a -1/-1 counter on target creature.

lines: {4}{G}{G}: Until end of turn, creatures you control have base power and toughness X/X, where X is the number of cards in your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect sets the base power and toughness of a group of creatures until end of turn: pumpEachUntilEot adds to them and becomeCreatureUntilEot affects one permanent.

cards.name: Oswald Fiddlebender
lines: Magical Tinkering — {W}, {T}, Sacrifice an artifact: Search your library for an artifact card with mana value equal to 1 plus the sacrificed artifact's mana value, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Misleading Signpost
lines: When this artifact enters during the declare attackers step, you may reselect which player or permanent target attacking creature is attacking.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op lets a player choose a new attack target for an attacking creature.

cards.name: Time Stretch
lines: Target player takes two extra turns after this one.
cards.inexpressibleReason: takeExtraTurn gives only the controller one extra turn, so it cannot give a target player two extra turns.

cards.backTranslation: Whenever another creature you control enters, this deals 2 damage to that creature. If that creature is a Dinosaur, this gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
differences: Text A gives the +2/+0 only if a Dinosaur was actually dealt damage by this ability ("dealt damage this way"); Text B gives it whenever the entering creature is a Dinosaur, even if no damage was dealt (for example, if the damage is prevented).

cards.name: Zombie Apocalypse
lines: Return all Zombie creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped, then destroy all Humans.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The mass graveyard-to-battlefield effect has no option to enter the battlefield tapped.

lines: {T}: Add an amount of {G} equal to your devotion to green.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Add {G} once for each point of your devotion to green.

cards.name: Robe of Stars
lines: Astral Projection — {1}{W}: Equipped creature phases out.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect phases out the equipped creature: it is not a chosen target, and phaseOutEachChosen requires a target slot.

cards.name: Impostor Syndrome

cards.backTranslation: Whenever a nontoken creature you control deals combat damage to a player, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except non-legendary.

cards.name: The Jolly Balloon Man

cards.inexpressibleReason: createTokenCopyOf can add card types and keywords but not the Balloon creature subtype or the added red color, so the copy cannot be made a 1/1 red Balloon in addition to its other types and colors.

cards.name: Spirit Link
lines: Whenever enchanted creature deals damage, you gain that much life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No trigger watches an attached creature dealing damage to any object; dealsDamageToOpponent and dealsCombatDamageToPlayer are narrower, and dealtDamage is the reverse event.

cards.name: Chivalric Alliance
lines: Whenever you attack with two or more creatures, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you attack with two or more creatures, draw a card.

cards.name: Flameshadow Conjuring
lines: Whenever a nontoken creature you control enters, you may pay {R}. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that creature. That token gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The token must be exiled at the beginning of the next end step, but the only end-step option is sacrificeAt (a sacrifice), so the exile cannot be written.

cards.name: Increasing Vengeance
lines: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. If this spell was cast from a graveyard, copy that spell twice instead. You may choose new targets for the copies.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition reads whether the resolving spell was cast from a graveyard, so 'copy that spell twice instead' cannot be gated on it.

cards.name: Tolarian Winds
lines: Discard all the cards in your hand, then draw that many cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value counts the cards just discarded by discardHand for the draw that follows, and eachPlayerDiscardHandThenDraw makes every player discard and draw rather than only the controller.

cards.name: Gimli of the Glittering Caves

cards.name: Esika's Chariot

cards.backTranslation: Whenever this permanent attacks, create a token that's a copy of target token you control.

cards.name: Empyrean Eagle
lines: Other creatures you control with flying get +1/+1.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The 'with flying' selector (hasKeyword) is marked event-only in the schema, so it cannot express a continuous 'other creatures you control with flying get +1/+1' static.

cards.name: Stonespeaker Crystal
lines: {2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Exile any number of target players' graveyards. Draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect exiles the graveyards of any number of chosen target players: exileTargetPlayerGraveyard takes one target, and exileEachOpponentGraveyard and exileAllGraveyards are untargeted and wrong for this text.

cards.name: Splash Portal
lines: Exile target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. If that creature is a Bird, Frog, Otter, or Rat, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The draw is conditional on the exiled creature's subtypes (Bird, Frog, Otter, or Rat), and no schema condition reads that creature's subtypes after the blink returns it as a new object, so the "if that creature is" branch cannot be placed to read the same object.

cards.name: Eaten Alive
lines: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or pay {3}{B}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The additional cost is a choice between sacrificing a creature and paying {3}{B}, and spellAdditionalCosts only lists costs that are all paid.

cards.name: Burnt Offering
lines: Add X mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}, where X is the sacrificed creature's mana value.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value reads the mana value of the creature sacrificed as an additional spell cost, so the amount of mana added cannot be stated.

cards.name: Temporal Trespass
lines: Delve
cards.inexpressibleReason: Delve (exiling graveyard cards to pay generic cost) has no schema representation, since exileOtherCardsFromGraveyard is an Escape-style cost, not a cost reduction.

cards.name: Carmen, Cruel Skymarcher

cards.name: Render Silent
lines: Counter target spell. Its controller can't cast spells this turn.

cards.name: Welding Jar

cards.name: Temple Altisaur

cards.name: Nuclear Fallout
lines: Each creature gets twice -X/-X until end of turn. Each player gets X rad counters.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect gives each player X rad counters (the player-counter effects cover poison and doubling only).

cards.name: Piper of the Swarm

cards.backTranslation: {2}{B}, {T}, Sacrifice three other Rats you control: Gain control of target creature.
differences: Text A's activation cost is {2}{B}{B}; Text B's is {2}{B}.
Text A requires sacrificing three Rats (the source itself may be one of them); Text B requires three other Rats, excluding the source.

cards.name: Peter Parker's Camera
lines: {2}, {T}, Remove a film counter from this artifact: Copy target activated or triggered ability you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
cards.inexpressibleReason: copyTargetAbility can name only one stack kind, so 'target activated or triggered ability you control' cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Reshape
lines: Search your library for an artifact card with mana value X or less, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A library search's mana value bound is a fixed number (manaValueAtMost), so it cannot be the announced X; the only X-bounded search (searchLibraryAndOrGraveyardToBattlefield) would also allow searching the graveyard.

cards.name: Redoubled Stormsinger
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, for each creature token you control that entered this turn, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of that token. At the beginning of the next end step, sacrifice those tokens.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op creates a separate tapped-and-attacking copy of each creature token that entered this turn, then sacrifices those copies at the next end step.

cards.name: Sovereign Okinec Ahau
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, for each creature you control with power greater than that creature's base power, put a number of +1/+1 counters on that creature equal to the difference.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The attack trigger puts on each creature you control a number of counters equal to that creature's own power minus its base power, and no Value reads that per-object difference when a putCountersEach effect applies it, so the count cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Saw It Coming
lines: Foretell {1}{U}
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no foretell keyword or foretell special action for the card itself; grantForetell only affects other cards in hand.

cards.name: Angel of Indemnity
lines: Encore {6}{W}{W}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Encore needs one token copy per opponent that attacks that specific opponent with haste and is sacrificed at the next end step; createTokenCopyOf has no per-opponent attacking form (its eachOpponent flag gives opponents control of the copies).

cards.name: Double Major
lines: Copy target creature spell you control, except it isn't legendary if the spell is legendary.
cards.inexpressibleReason: copyTargetSpell cannot make the copy non-legendary only when the original spell is legendary, so the "except it isn't legendary if the spell is legendary" clause cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Phyrexian Vindicator
lines: If damage would be dealt to this creature, prevent that damage. When damage is prevented this way, this creature deals that much damage to any other target.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The prevented damage must be redirected to any other target chosen by the controller, but a damage shield can only reflect to the damage source's controller or the source creature.

cards.name: Ravenous Squirrel
lines: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact or creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever an artifact or creature you control is sacrificed, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

cards.name: Alpha Authority
lines: Enchanted creature has hexproof and can't be blocked by more than one creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: minBlockers means 'can't be blocked except by N or more creatures', and no restriction caps the number of blockers at one ('can't be blocked by more than one creature').

cards.name: Witch's Oven
lines: {T}, Sacrifice a creature: Create a Food token. If the sacrificed creature's toughness was 4 or greater, create two Food tokens instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Food count depends on the toughness of the creature sacrificed as the cost, and no Value reads the toughness of a sacrificed object.

cards.name: Autumn's Veil
lines: Spells you control can't be countered by blue or black spells this turn, and creatures you control can't be the targets of blue or black spells this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no this-turn restriction that stops blue or black spells from countering the controller's spells or targeting their creatures.

cards.name: Crawling Sensation
lines: Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere for the first time each turn, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever one or more lands you own are put into a graveyard from anywhere, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
differences: Text A triggers only when land cards are put into your graveyard; Text B triggers when lands you own are put into any graveyard, including an opponent's graveyard.

cards.name: River's Rebuke
lines: Return all nonland permanents target player controls to their owner's hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: returnToHandEach takes a selector that cannot refer to the chosen target player's control, so 'nonland permanents target player controls' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Fertilid
lines: {1}{G}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: Target player searches their library for a basic land card, puts it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffles.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The ability's target player must search their own library, but searchLibrary has no player field and always searches the ability's controller's library.

cards.name: Diamond City
lines: {T}: Move a shield counter from this land onto target creature. Activate only if two or more creatures entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
cards.backTranslation:
{G}, {T}: Activate only if you control two or more creatures that entered the battlefield this turn.
Move a shield counter from this land onto target creature.
differences: Text B adds a {G} mana cost to the activation; Text A's ability costs only {T}.
Text A's ability has no mana cost, so the activation in Text B requires paying {G} that Text A does not require.

cards.name: Nesting Dovehawk
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, populate.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of combat on your turn, populate.

cards.name: Infantry Shield
lines: Equipped creature has menace and mobilize X, where X is its power.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Mobilize X's granted attack trigger must sacrifice the created tokens at the beginning of the next end step, and no token-creation op (createTokenAttacking) carries that delayed sacrifice.

cards.name: Chitterspitter
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may sacrifice a token. If you do, put an acorn counter on this artifact.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may sacrifice a token you control. If you do, put an acorn counter on this.

cards.name: Weapons Manufacturing
lines: Whenever a nontoken artifact you control enters, create a colorless artifact token named Munitions with "When this token leaves the battlefield, it deals 2 damage to any target."
cards.backTranslation: Whenever an artifact you control that isn't a token enters, create a colorless Munitions artifact token with "When this token leaves the battlefield, it deals 2 damage to any target."

cards.name: Heap Gate
lines: {1}, {T}, Tap an untapped Gate you control: Create a Treasure token.
cards.backTranslation: {1}, {T}, Tap another Gate you control: Create a colorless Treasure artifact token with "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color."
differences: Text A requires the tapped Gate to be an untapped Gate you control; Text B requires another Gate you control with no untapped requirement, so a tapped Gate would be a legal choice in Text B but not in Text A.

cards.name: Overmaster
lines: The next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn can't be countered.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect makes the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn uncounterable: Ability.cantBeCountered is a fixed property of a spell, and nextCastThisTurn only attaches a triggered ability.
